vet.fail_3: radio not fitted (BUSY/DIO1/MISO float) — likely a no-radio build (declare it)

notes: first unit of the eight with the unfixed DIR strap — the vet's very first check was written for exactly this and it fired
GPIO16 LOW is specifically U5 driving: an unpowered LVC1T45 (no VCCB) would go high-Z and the pin would float; LOW means U5 has 5 V and DIR is low
